pull_request.title: Tracker: Add 0.8 mm beryllium beampipe at 27 mm
pull_request.head: codex/beryllium-beampipe
pull_request.body:
Adds the requested straight0.8mm beryllium beampipe as an independently testable DD4hep component with an explicit vacuum bore (DES-024, DRAFT). Assumes27mm is the inner radius (outer27.8mm); retains provisional±4m extent. No tracker layout, sensor identifier or service limit changes.

Validation: two CTests pass, zero ROOT overlaps at1e-5mm, analytical shell mass2036.162g and15 directional wall-material checks pass; one seeded transverse geantino DDSim event completed. Exact execution hashes and failed setup attempts are retained in docs/validation/DES-024. Logger validation and dashboard validation/build pass.

The follow-up assembles BeamPipe+full Tracker and derives ACTS Gen3 geometry from DD4hep. Mechanical/vacuum/forward-transition qualification is pending; no engineering sign-off is inferred. Exact active-turn tokens remain unavailable and are explicitly unrecorded in the shared task journal.

events.text:
The existing pixel support and service apertures start at radius 27 mm, so a pipe with 27 mm inner radius and 27.8 mm outer radius intersects them. Which integration convention should I use?
- Keep 27 mm inner radius; enlarge only passive apertures to 28.8 mm (recommended, gives 1 mm clearance)
- Use 27 mm outer radius; retain existing apertures (nominal contact, no clearance)
